decisions.reason: The DPA management tool is close to the core offer, fits the stated compliance direction, and drew positive agency feedback, so it meets aspirations at low carrying cost and gives no reason for problemistic search.

As the flagship agency management platform shown on the home page in a growing market, it anchors the firm's strategic direction, and slack allows it to be carried even if early results are uncertain.

Extended PHP security support builds on the existing hosting stack and serves the security and compliance promise at low cost, though its mere mention on the website and its tie to legacy PHP versions make it somewhat more expendable.
